hero.body: {org} is a home for combat veterans in civilian life, and you're invited to be part of it.

steps.title: Leave your name and phone number
steps.body: In the short form in our registration system. If you've checked in at a meeting from this phone, it takes one tap.

steps.title: Someone from our team gets back to you
steps.body: With all the details about joining.

how.privacy: Your details are used only to get back to you about joining. Only our team sees them.
